new_today_news.headline: Keeping 'FOG' Out of Your Pipes This Holiday Season
new_today_news.summary: Baltimore County Public Works announces seasonal FOG awareness campaign emphasizing restaurant inspection protocols and proper grease disposal. Educational outreach notes that all food service establishments receive regular sewer system inspections for FOG accumulation.

backfill_news.headline: Washington County Completes Smithsburg Wastewater Treatment Plant Upgrade
backfill_news.summary: Washington County completed an Enhanced Nutrient Removal upgrade and expansion of the Smithsburg Wastewater Treatment Plant, increasing capacity from 0.333 to 0.45 million gallons per day (a 35% increase) while improving nitrogen and phosphorus removal to meet current standards.
